ja339:1.1: Adassanena morassa sikhino mañjubhāṇino kākaṃ tattha apūjesuṃ maṃsena ca phalena ca.
ja339:2.1: Yadā ca sarasampanno moro Bāverum āgamā atha lābho ca sakkāro vāyasassa ahāyatha.
ja339:3.1: Yāva n' uppajjati Buddho dhammarājā pabhaṃkaro tāva aññe apūjesuṃ puthū samaṇabrāhmaṇe.
ja339:4.1: Yadā ca sarasampanno Buddho dhammam adesayi atha lābho ca sakkāro titthiyānaṃ ahāyathā ti.
